senses.gloss: m. (preced.) one known to be skilled in boring and stealing wine.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 7:14">Tosef. Ab. Zar. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 8:14">VIII</cite>), 14 <he>יין אצל גוי הש׳ וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. <he>מהסתם</he>, <he>הסתמם</he>, corrupt. of <he>המְשַׁתֵּם</he>) if one deposited wine with a gentile who is known as an expert borer, it is forbidden &c. (v. <cite ref="N00948"><he>נֶסֶךְ</he></cite>).
